_comment: Configuration for tools/morning_briefing.py. Edit this file (not the script) to teach the briefing about new factors, rename setups, tune thresholds, or add new liquidity-level priorities. Combo/factor edges are auto-parsed from the study output files under 'sources' — re-run those studies and the briefing learns.

live_data.note: Uses the public Yahoo Finance v8/chart endpoint — no auth, no dependency outside stdlib. NQ=F returns continuous front-month NQ with 1-minute bars including pre/post market. Works for the overnight → pre-open window we need.

gap_up.desc: cash opens above prior RTH close

gap_down.desc: cash opens below prior RTH close

tight_overnight.desc: overnight range in bottom 20% of history

wide_overnight.desc: overnight range in top 20% of history

prior_day_up.desc: prior RTH closed in top 25% of its range

prior_day_down.desc: prior RTH closed in bottom 25% of its range

low_vixy.desc: VIXY prior close in bottom quartile

normal_vixy.desc: VIXY prior close in the middle quartile

elevated_vixy.desc: VIXY prior close in top two quartiles

has_red_folder.desc: at least one red-folder event on the calendar

not_fomc_week.desc: this week does not contain an FOMC statement

is_fomc_week.desc: FOMC week — historical edge collapses, be cautious

macro_w1.desc: 9:30–9:45 ET — the strongest macro window in the sample

short_only.desc: filter that applies to short entries only

long_only.desc: filter that applies to long entries only

tight_45min_or.desc: 45-min OR in bottom 20% — HARD stand-down signal

level_groups._comment: Priorities for the Liquidity Levels section. hit_rate_45m = probability the level is touched within 9:30–10:15 when within 100 pts of open. wr_as_magnet = FVGC trade WR when that group is the nearest magnet within 3R (from data/levels/analysis.md, Apr 2026 rebuild). tier is a manual rollup: A = primary target / strong draw, B = secondary, C = weaker / avoid as sole magnet.

htf_fvg_1H.note: Fresh unmitigated 1H FVG — top WR when it IS the draw, even though hit rate is lower. Respect as primary.

htf_fvg_15m.note: 15m unfilled FVG — strongest in macro 2 (9:45–10:00), 69% WR there.

prev_day.note: Prior RTH high/low. Reliable continuation target.

asia.note: Strictly a macro-1 target — WR drops to 40% in macro 2.

bsl_ssl.note: London swing H/L — tiny sample but elite PF when it IS the magnet.

nwog.note: Monday only. NWOG within 25 pts + flat gap → 93% hit rate.

6am.note: Forms at 10:00 ET — only draws in macro 3.

htf_fvg_Daily.note: Daily FVGs within 50 pts of open have ~97% hit rate — if close, respect.

overnight.note: Often swept as part of the opening drive rather than acting as a clean draw.

london.note: High hit rate but sub-baseline WR as nearest magnet. Never target London in macro 3.

htf_fvg_4H.note: Too wide a zone for a clean 45-min target.

distance_bucket_hit_rates._comment: From study_level_hit_rate_45min.py — hit probability vs distance from RTH open (any group).

manual_one_liners.say: Gap-down on a weak prior close — classic short-bias setup. If the 9:30 closes bearish and the 45-min OR widens out, treat the first 9:30–9:45 FVGC short as a high-confidence multi-R play.
FOMC week — historical edge evaporates (baseline WR ~44%). Be very selective, smaller size, and prefer to stand down on any tight-OR morning.
Pre-RTH red-folder print (NFP/CPI style). Let the dust settle, watch for the 45-min OR to print wide, and avoid chasing the first impulse.
Elevated vol regime after a weak close. Short setups have historically been strongest here — align with the 9:30–9:45 macro window.
Prior-day-up + gap-up is one of the weaker static profiles in the sample. Demand strong confirmation (wide 45-min OR + bearish 9:30 for a fade) before sizing up.

day_of_week_notes.Monday: Monday is middling in the sample (WR ~50.5%). NWOG comes into play today only.
day_of_week_notes.Tuesday: Tuesday is the weakest day in the sample (WR ~49.2%). Stay selective.
day_of_week_notes.Wednesday: Wednesday is middling (WR ~50.9%). Longs have historically been the weaker side.
day_of_week_notes.Thursday: Thursday is the STRONGEST day in the sample (WR ~55.8%, +$920 total PnL). Short Thursday drives most of the edge.
day_of_week_notes.Friday: Friday is average (WR ~51.9%). Watch for OpEx and witching weeks.
